description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named OperatorsPanel for a calculator application, managing UI state and interactions related to calculator operators, including bit flip and error visual states.

classes.name: OperatorsPanel
classes.description: A partial class representing a user control for calculator operators, handling UI state and interactions.

methods.name: OnIsBitFlipCheckedPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the IsBitFlipChecked property, ensuring the programmer bit flip panel is displayed when checked.

methods.name: OnIsErrorVisualStatePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the visual state of operator controls based on the error state and current calculator mode.

methods.name: EnsureScientificOps
methods.description: Ensures the scientific operators UI element is loaded.

methods.name: EnsureProgrammerRadixOps
methods.description: Ensures the programmer radix operators UI element is loaded and checks default bit shift.

methods.name: EnsureProgrammerBitFlipPanel
methods.description: Ensures the programmer bit flip panel UI element is loaded.
